paragraphs: Thanks for stopping by. This year Brickwater is once again heading out with a guitar case and a harmonica, a legal drug pressing the little buttons at the back of your head. Dopamine for the smile in between, serotonin to take the edge off the pain. Solo or with Folk's Worst Nightmare, on cobblestones, in a forest clearing or on a festival stage: Brickwater works.

Sound-wise it is as 'brickwaterish' as ever, somewhere in the spheres between indie, folk and punk. Frontperson Bricky Waters, born and raised on soul and R'n'B and later swept into political punk rock, loves getting lost between genres. Once the shouting front man of the rascal punk 'n' roll band 'King Lui van Beethoven' and later a founding member of the Folk's Worst Nightmare collective, he plays songs with depth and levity, melancholy and reflection, with brains and heart, beautiful melodies and personal lyrics. Take as needed. Avoid underdosing!
short: Indie, folk and punk from Nuremberg. Solo or with the Folk's Worst Nightmare collective, on cobblestones, in forest clearings or on festival stages.
fwn: Brickwater is a founding member of Folk's Worst Nightmare, a Nuremberg collective of singer-songwriters and folk punks who tour together, release records together and back each other up on stage.
